other_conditions: Must be a resident of Karnataka and possess a valid resident certificate
Must be engaged in handloom, power loom, or ancillary activities such as cotton, wool, or silk
Must be a financially distressed worker in the handloom/textile sector
Must have an active bank account
Must be registered on the Seva Sindhu portal of Karnataka
benefits_summary: Eligible weavers receive an annual financial assistance of Rs.2000 (increased to Rs.5000 for 2022‑23) transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer.
